newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan auctions federal investment bonds.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan auctions federal investment bonds.

text.p: The State (central) Bank of Pakistan said it had auctioned on Monday three-year and 10-year maturity federal investment bonds (FIBs) worth a total of 534.529 million rupees.
The bank said it accepted bids worth 100 million rupees at par for three-year maturity bonds and 434.526 million rupees for 10-year bonds. No bids were received for five-year bonds.
The auction is set for settlement on Wednesday.
In the previous auction on October 29, the bank accepted bids worth 80.3928 million rupees at par for three-year maturity bonds and 598.55 million rupees at par for 10-year bonds.
